name: 18424-eagledecode-8b-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 -- one whole a3 node, `--gres=gpu:8`.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1. Draft TP is left unset and defaults to the target's tensor_parallel_size.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, bf16, 8.03B params = 16.1 GB; the draft is a one-layer EAGLE head over the same vocab, ~0.78B, and takes its dtype from the target.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=2, bounded at 1200 requests / 1800 s safety, first 10% and last 10% discarded.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: 128 prompt tokens (min = max) and 512 output tokens (min = max, implemented as ignore_eos), greedy (temperature 0.0), seed 18424.
purpose: A low-latency 8B chat assistant with speculative drafting, serving two concurrent users short prompts across eight GPUs.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit ec82c3e388b962a30a02fa376c222cef787b3c14 (v0.9.0~73).
#   Interpreter and hardware seal: configs/env.yaml (NOT portable, per-machine).
#
# HAZARD: WRITE EVERY VALUE ON ONE LINE. This file is read flat -- every line starting with a
# space is dropped -- so re-flowing `speculative-config` into a block mapping parses to nothing
# and the engine starts with NO SPECULATIVE DECODING AT ALL, silently.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle", "model": "yuhuili/EAGLE-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B", "num_speculative_tokens": 3, "max_model_len": 2048}
tensor-parallel-size: 8

# 2048 is forced: the draft checkpoint's own `max_position_embeddings` is 2048.
max-model-len: 2048

# Headroom above the declared 2 streams, so the engine's admission cap is not what pins the
# operating point.
max-num-seqs: 8

max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# Overrides the V1 default of true at this commit.
enable-prefix-caching: false

enforce-eager: false
